_doc: Every environment key a genesis-ceremony phase reads, by class. Kept in step with the scripts by phase_inputs.py check-spec (a tripwire in the genesis-scripts suite and CI); P0 checks the p0/late/unset entries through phase_inputs.py preflight before anything is sent. See phase_inputs.py for the classes.

SIGNER_1.why: InstitutionalVault 2-of-3 signer (DeployEduStack); unset falls back to the deployer and the three must be distinct, which fails P2 after earlier steps broadcast

RELAYER.why: the institutional relayer (DeployEduStack); unset falls back to the deployer, which must hold nothing after the handover

CITRATE_AA_OWNER.why: owner of the AA stack (aa/DeployAA requires it, mid-P2)

CITRATE_AA_IDENTITY_SIGNER.why: the deploy-permit signer (aa/DeployAA requires it, mid-P2)

CITRATE_AA_SPONSOR_SIGNER.why: the paymaster sponsorship signer, a separate key from the identity signer (aa/DeployAA, separation of duties)

MEMBERSHIP_OWNER.why: membership owner (DeployCoreMembership, P2's last step); on 40204 it must not be the deployer

TREASURY.why: the fee recipient DeployAll sets at construction (X402Facilitator, ModelMarketplace, ComputeMarketplace); never the deployer, and required on 40204

DEPLOYER_ADDRESS.why: the ceremony deployer; P0 checks it and binds it in the run manifest

CEREMONY_DEPLOYER_ADDRESS.why: C9: a preset value must be DEPLOYER_ADDRESS byte for byte; P0 then sets it

RPC_URL.why: the chain; P0 reads chain id and block 0 through it

TEAM_VESTING_FILE.why: the owner's vesting schedule; P0 checks that the file exists, and --confirm requires it

PATRONAGE_KYC_REGISTRY.why: PatronageLedger's KYC registry; deployed under GOVERNANCE after P1, so a fresh run checks it at P4 before P4 sends

PATRONAGE_MEMBERSHIP.why: PatronageLedger's coop membership SBT; deployed under GOVERNANCE after P1, so a fresh run checks it at P4 before P4 sends

GOVERNANCE.why: load_governance sets it from P1's recorded output (C2)

GUARDIAN.why: load_governance sets it from P1's recorded output (C2)

GOVERNANCE_TIMELOCK.why: load_governance sets it from P1's recorded output (C2)

GOVERNANCE_MULTISIG.why: load_governance sets it from P1's recorded output (C2)

VALIDATOR_REGISTRY.why: regenesis.sh captures it from the DeployValidatorRegistry broadcast

GENESIS_PROFILE.why: P1 always runs the genesis profile

ADDRESS_BOOK.why: P5 hands the checker its merged book

REQUIRE_ALL_CODE.why: P5 always requires code at every book address

CITRATE_VALIDATOR_REGISTRY.why: a fallback DeployCoreMembership reads only when VALIDATOR_REGISTRY is unset, and regenesis.sh sets that from the broadcast

CITRATE_AA_DAILY_CAP.why: AA per-wallet daily cap (wei), default 0.01 ether

CITRATE_AA_MAX_FEE_CEIL.why: AA max fee ceiling (wei), default 20 gwei

CITRATE_AA_GLOBAL_CAP.why: AA global daily cap (wei), default 5 ether

CITRATE_AA_ENTRY_POINT.why: the EntryPoint is CREATE2-deployed at its projected address; a pin that differs fails aa/DeployAA mid-P2

P256_VERIFIER_INITCODE.why: the verifier is deployed from the vendored init code; an override that does not produce P256.VERIFIER fails mid-P2

P256_VERIFIER_SALT.why: the verifier is deployed with the vendored salt; an override fails mid-P2
